parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Magnesium has a melting point of $650^{\circ}\text{C}$ and high electrical conductivity.

Explain these properties of magnesium by referring to its structure and bonding.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: When magnesium is heated in air, magnesium oxide, $\text{MgO}$, is the major product. Smaller amounts of magnesium nitride, $\text{Mg}_3\text{N}_2$, are also made.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the type of reaction which takes place between magnesium and nitrogen. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
When $3.645\text{ g}$ of $\text{Mg(s)}$ burns in excess $\text{N}_2\text{(g)}$ to form $\text{Mg}_3\text{N}_2\text{(s)}$, $23.05\text{ kJ}$ of energy is released.

Calculate the enthalpy change of formation, $\Delta H_{\text{f}}$, of $\text{Mg}_3\text{N}_2$. Show your working.
